remarks: Sweeping vineyard views and one of the larger backyards in Trilogy at The Vineyards! This single-story home sits in Brentwood’s gated 55+ resort community. Inside, 10-foot ceilings, rich wood floors, and recessed lighting give the home a bright, open feel. Enjoy a true chef's kitchen, built around a generous center island with a gas cooktop, stainless appliances, and warm wood cabinetry. Thoughtful storage includes a separate walk-in pantry, tucked-away trash and recycling, pull-out shelving, and extra-deep soft-close cookware drawers. The kitchen opens to the family room in a true great room concept, an easy space for hosting friends or enjoying cozy evenings with views of the vineya
